query: Which equity and accessibility protocols (translation/back-translation, culturally adapted cases, low-bandwidth PD) and metrics will detect differential learning gains by SES, language, or resources?

response.query: Which equity and accessibility protocols (translation/back-translation, culturally adapted cases, low-bandwidth PD) and metrics will detect differential learning gains by SES, language, or resources?
response.answer: Equity protocols include translation/back-translation and culturally adapted cases; metrics for differential learning gains focus on SES, language, and resources. Key metrics are standardized test scores and student performance data.
